$comment: RFC-002: the pinned upstream TUI tarball this distribution is built from. The tarball itself is NOT committed (18 MB, and the repository is public); this record pins the exact bytes so any offline copy can be proven to be the same input. scripts/build-package.mjs verifies --upstream against every field before it unpacks anything.
notes: fileCount is recorded by the first successful build into dist/build-report.json; the builder asserts the product file set equals this tarball's file set plus the documented additions.
